// Review check fixture. Plain text: never imported, built or deployed.
interface Env { DB: D1Database }

export async function sessionAttendance(eventId: string, env: Env): Promise<Response> {
  const rows = await env.DB.prepare(
    'SELECT session_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM scans WHERE event_id = ?1 GROUP BY session_id',
  )
    .bind(eventId)
    .all<{ session_id: string; n: number }>();
  const sessions = rows.results.map((r) => ({ sessionId: r.session_id, checkIns: r.n }));
  return Response.json({ eventId, sessions });
}
